faq.q: Is Baichuan AI free?

faq.q: How long does the Baichuan gift balance last?

faq.q: Does Baichuan AI need a credit card?
faq.a: No. Signup at https://platform.baichuan-ai.com needs only an email.

faq.q: Which Baichuan model has the longest context?
faq.a: Baichuan3-Turbo-128k, with a 131K-token context window.

You can use eleven_v4, eleven_v4_turbo, eleven_v3, eleven_multilingual_v2 and eleven_flash_v2_5 for speech, and scribe_v2 for speech-to-text. The API is at https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1.

faq.q: Does ElevenLabs offer speech-to-text on the free plan?

seo.title: OVHcloud AI Endpoints: Free EU-Hosted API, No Key
seo.description: Call OVHcloud AI Endpoints without a key at 2 RPM per IP per model. EU-hosted, OpenAI-compatible, models like gpt-oss-120b and Qwen3.5.
seo.intro: OVHcloud AI Endpoints is a European, OpenAI-compatible inference service you can call without an account or key. Anonymous requests are limited to 2 per minute for each IP and model, which is fine for testing and too slow for anything else. A key raises that to 400 requests per minute, but that is the paid plan. Eight models are open this way, including Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, gpt-oss-120b, Meta-Llama-3_3-70B-Instruct, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct and the bge-m3 embedding model. The base URL is https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1.

faq.q: Is OVHcloud AI Endpoints free?
faq.a: Yes for anonymous use, which is limited to 2 requests per minute per IP per model. Higher limits with a key are paid.

faq.q: Do I need an API key for OVHcloud AI Endpoints?
faq.a: No. You can send requests without a key. A key gives 400 requests per minute on the paid plan.

faq.q: Where is OVHcloud AI Endpoints hosted?
faq.a: In Europe, which suits teams that want EU-hosted inference.

faq.q: Does OVHcloud have a free embedding model?
faq.a: Yes. bge-m3 is available anonymously at the same 2 RPM limit.

seo.title: Pollinations Free API: No Signup, No API Key
seo.description: Call Pollinations' OpenAI-compatible endpoint with no account and no key. Anonymous requests get openai-fast (GPT-OSS 20B) with 131K context.
seo.intro: Pollinations is one of two providers on this site you can call without an account; OVHcloud AI Endpoints is the other. Send a request to text.pollinations.ai/openai with no key and you get openai-fast, which runs GPT-OSS 20B with a 131K context window. That makes it handy for quick demos, workshops and throwaway scripts where managing a key is more trouble than it's worth. A free key unlocks more models. Pollinations doesn't publish rate limits for anonymous use, so don't build anything that has to stay up on it.

faq.q: Does Pollinations need an API key?
faq.a: No. Anonymous requests to https://text.pollinations.ai/openai work without a key. Registering for a key unlocks more models.

faq.q: Which model does the Pollinations free API use?
faq.a: Anonymous requests use openai-fast, which is GPT-OSS 20B with a 131K context window.

faq.q: Can I use Pollinations with the OpenAI SDK?

faq.q: Is Zenmux free?

faq.q: What is the Zenmux API base URL?

seo.description: OrcaRouter has a free auto-router plus $0 model IDs for DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and Tencent Hy3. API key required, no card.
seo.intro: OrcaRouter is an OpenAI-compatible router with two ways to use it for free. faq.q: What is orcarouter/free?
faq.a: It is an auto-router model ID. Send requests to it and OrcaRouter picks one of its free models to answer.

faq.q: Is OrcaRouter completely free?
faq.a: The $0 model IDs and orcarouter/free cost nothing per token, but some offers require a deposit first.

faq.q: What are OrcaRouter's free rate limits?
faq.a: OrcaRouter doesn't publish them for the free models. Test with your real workload before you rely on it.

name: OpenCode Zen

seo.title: OpenCode Zen Free API: Rotating Free Models
seo.description: OpenCode Zen offers a rotating set of free models, including big-pickle and glm-5.3-flash-free, on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. No card needed.
seo.intro: OpenCode Zen is the model gateway run by the OpenCode coding agent, and it keeps a rotating set of free models on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. At our check on 2026-11-05 there were ten, including big-pickle, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash-free and nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free, and several had a 1M-token context window. You need an account and an API key, but no credit card. The list rotates, so a model ID that works today can disappear. Prompts sent to free models may also be used for training, so keep private code and customer data out of them.

faq.q: Is OpenCode Zen free?
faq.a: Yes, for the models marked free. The free set rotates, so check the current list before you hard-code a model ID.

faq.q: Does OpenCode Zen train on my prompts?
faq.a: Prompts sent to the free models may be used for training. Use a paid model or another provider for sensitive data.

faq.q: Do I need an API key for OpenCode Zen?
faq.a: Yes. Create an account at opencode.ai to get a key. No credit card is required.
